The '''Village''' is a [[Location]] on the [[Hub Island]] with many vendors and various [[NPC]]s. It is visited by the player when one first leaves their [[Private Island]] through the portal.

{{ZoneText|Explore the area to learn more about &bSkyBlock&f.|Visit the &6Auction House&f.|Manage your &6coins &fin the &6Bank&f.|Enchant items in the &bLibrary&f.}}
== Features ==
The '''Village''' serves as a starting point for SkyBlock players. It features a variety of buildings, [[NPCs]], and branching off points to other [[Locations]] on the [[Hub Island]] and beyond.

=== Buildings ===
{{:Locations/Hub Island|village_only=yes}}

=== Map ===
The [[Map (Hub)|Hub Map]] is located in front of spawn. The map displays most islands with the exception of seasonal islands.

[[File:Hub Map (0.24.2).png|300px|Hub World Map]]

=== Portal to Private Island ===
The Portal to a player's [[Private Island]] is found in the center of the village.

=== Adjacent Areas ===
The Village is connected to many other sections of the [[Hub Island]]. These locations include:
* The {{Zone|Forest}} to the left, which leads to {{Zone|The Park}}.
* The {{Zone|Combat Settlement}} to the middle left, which leads to the {{Zone|Graveyard}} and {{Zone|Spider's Den}}.
* The {{Zone|Mining District}} straight forward, which leads to the {{Zone|Gold Mine}}.
* The {{Zone|Farm}} to the middle right, which leads to {{Zone|The Barn}}.
* The {{Zone|Fishing Outpost}} to the right, which grants access to the [[Ship Navigator]] and various [[Fishing Island]]s.
* The {{Zone|Wilderness}}, {{Zone|Mountain}}, {{Zone|Ruins}}, and other areas.

=== Conditional Builds ===
==== Events ====
During certain [[Events]], parts of the '''Village''' will have its build changed. For example, the [[Event Square]] can be found to the left of the Village, where a fountain and the portal to the {{Zone|Dungeon Hub}} is located. Events and their respective [[NPCs]] can be accessed here, such as:
* The [[Spooky Festival]] and the {{NPCSprite|Fear Mongerer}}
* The [[Season of Jerry]] and {{NPCSprite|Jerry}}
** The [[New Year Celebration]] and the {{NPCSprite|Baker}}
* The [[Traveling Zoo]] and {{NPCSprite|Oringo}}

During other events, such as the [[Year of the Pig]], [[Year of the Witch|Witch]], or [[Year of the Seal|Seal]], a section between the {{Zone|Community Center}} and {{Zone|Museum}} will change to be themed around the respective event.

Similarly, when {{NPCSprite|Simon}} appeared during the [[Raffle of the Century]], a section between the {{Zone|Community Center}} and {{Zone|Auction House}} had its build changed, to allow players to participate in the event.

==== Updates ====
When new [[SkyBlock]] updates are released, builds and [[NPCs]] are sometimes added to the '''Village''' to announce their addition.
